name: modedb-ecosystem
description: ModeDB-Ecosystem — pnpm monorepo orchestration root; engine in packages/core (@mode-db/core), server, SDK, shared, common

scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:common && pnpm run build:data-kit && pnpm run build:data-ui && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:sdk && node scripts/obfuscate-dist.mjs
scripts.dev:data-studio: pnpm run build:data-ui && pnpm --filter data-studio dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:common && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:data-kit && pnpm run build:data-ui && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:data-kit && tsx --test test/unit/field-defs.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-query-adapter.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-binding.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-phase2.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-phase3.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-relation-bind.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-apply-outcome.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-insert-many-failures.test.ts test/unit/data-kit-coerce-import.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:common && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:sdk && tsx test/integration/e2e-engine-workflow.ts && tsx test/integration/relate-conserved-forest.ts && tsx test/integration/children-tree-query.ts && tsx test/integration/group-lateral-attach.ts && tsx test/integration/multi-branch-network.ts && tsx test/integration/protocol-operations.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run check:sources && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
